column4: Original ctor Permanent(List<CardSource>) plus SetCardSources bulk-seed a per-instance under-card list via Clone+AddCardSource loop; the port Permanent is a transient view over DigivolutionStack state with no per-instance list and no SetCardSources method (its ctors take EngineContext/HeadlessEntityId).

Original seeds the no-level base to the 1145140 sentinel (TopCard.Level returns it, plus explicit !HasLevel branch); the port seeds TopCard.Level whose no-level sentinel is -1, so the level-less base value differs (-1 vs 1145140) and the explicit sentinel branch is dropped.

oldIsTapped_playCard is a plain bool auto-property in the original but is backed by an OldIsTappedPlayCardStore dictionary keyed by InstanceId in the port (identical get/set and default-false semantics).

PermanentFrame resolves the slot from the fixed TopCard.Owner.FieldPermanents array and returns a pre-built fieldCardFrames[index]; the port uses new Player(_context,OwnerId).GetFieldPermanents() list index and constructs new FieldCardFrame(...) on demand (no slot/frame arrays in mirror Player).
DiscardEvoRoots is an IEnumerator using yield return StartCoroutine(...); the port is async Task using await (and .Clone() becomes new List<>()), body otherwise statement-for-statement identical.
PermanentView sealed class (read-only view over DigivolutionStack exposing DigivolutionCards/IsEmpty/TopInstanceId) has no counterpart anywhere in the original tree.

Permanent value-equality suite (Equals/GetHashCode/operator==/operator!=) keyed on InstanceId plus _context is invented; the original Permanent defines none and relies on reference identity of the persistent Unity object.

SnapshotZone (D-2 pre-removal field-zone snapshot consumed by OnLeaveFieldAnyone gates) is a headless-invented member and ctor param; no SnapshotZone/ChoiceZone snapshot concept exists in the original tree.
DP fold's face-up-security gate uses !cardSource.IsFlipped in original but SecurityFaceState.IsFaceUpInSecurity(_context, InstanceId) in port [Headless.Runtime.SecurityFaceState]
Level original wraps body in `if (TopCard != null)` and returns 0 for null; port dereferences TopCard.Level unguarded (no null path / NRE)

Level original re-asserts `if (!TopCard.HasLevel) Level = 1145140` no-level sentinel; port omits it, relying on mirror TopCard.Level whose sentinel is -1 (folded upstream in CardSource.Level/PrintedLevel)
GetDP player enumeration GManager.instance.turnStateMachine.gameContext.Players_ForTurnPlayer becomes new GameContext(_context).Players_ForTurnPlayer
GetDP face-up security gate !cardSource.IsFlipped becomes !SecurityFaceState.IsFaceUpInSecurity(_context, InstanceId) [Headless.Runtime.SecurityFaceState]
DP getter opens an AmbientMatchContext.Scope for the fold with no original counterpart [AmbientMatchContext.Enter]
DP getter player enumeration GManager.instance.turnStateMachine.gameContext.Players_ForTurnPlayer becomes new GameContext(_context).Players_ForTurnPlayer
DP getter face-up security gate !cardSource.IsFlipped becomes !SecurityFaceState.IsFaceUpInSecurity(_context, InstanceId) [Headless.Runtime.SecurityFaceState]
LinkedDP plain { get; set; } auto-property becomes CardInstanceRepository metadata-backed get/set on LinkedDpKey [CardInstanceRepository metadata / LinkedDpKey]
CannotReturnToHand player enumeration GManager.instance.turnStateMachine.gameContext.Players becomes new GameContext(_context).Players
CannotReturnToLibrary player enumeration GManager.instance.turnStateMachine.gameContext.Players becomes new GameContext(_context).Players
HasBlocker collision short-circuit GManager.instance.attackProcess becomes AttackProcess.For(_context) (ActiveAttack and AttackingPermanent)
HasBlocker player enumeration GManager.instance.turnStateMachine.gameContext.Players_ForTurnPlayer becomes new GameContext(_context).Players_ForTurnPlayer
HasJamming player enumeration GManager.instance.turnStateMachine.gameContext.Players_ForTurnPlayer becomes new GameContext(_context).Players_ForTurnPlayer
HasIceclad player enumeration GManager.instance.turnStateMachine.gameContext.Players_ForTurnPlayer becomes new GameContext(_context).Players_ForTurnPlayer
Boosts is a plain List<DPBoost> field in original but a computed read-only view over id->dp instance metadata in port [CardInstanceRepository metadata key DpBoostsKey "dpBoosts"]
Port never persists DPBoost.Condition (id->dp map only), so reconstructed Boosts always carry null Condition; behaviorally inert since AS-IS never reads boost.Condition anywhere
ImmuneFromDPMinus body identical except the roster source GManager.instance.turnStateMachine.gameContext.Players is swapped for new GameContext(_context).Players
CannotReturnToHand identical incl. nested player-loop quirk except roster source swap [new GameContext(_context).Players]
CannotReturnToLibrary identical incl. nested player-loop quirk except roster source swap [new GameContext(_context).Players]
ImmuneFromDeDigivolve body identical except roster source swap [new GameContext(_context).Players]
ImmuneFromStackTrashing body identical except roster source swap [new GameContext(_context).Players]

HasReboot (representative of all Has* scan members) sources players via new GameContext(_context).Players_ForTurnPlayer instead of GManager.instance.turnStateMachine.gameContext.Players_ForTurnPlayer; tiers/conditions otherwise identical.
HasRush body identical except turn-order roster source swap [new GameContext(_context).Players_ForTurnPlayer]
HasAlliance body identical except turn-order roster source swap [new GameContext(_context).Players_ForTurnPlayer]
HasCollision body identical except turn-order roster source swap [new GameContext(_context).Players_ForTurnPlayer]
IsSuspended AS-IS public mutable field becomes a metadata-backed property (IsSuspendedKey "isSuspended" via CardInstanceRepository.Metadata) [CardInstanceRecord.Metadata IsSuspendedKey]
OldIsSuspended public bool field is entirely absent from the port with no functional replacement (IsSuspended is present separately; no OldIsSuspended fold found)

AS-IS cardSources is a live list where AddLinkCard Insert(1,...) interleaves newest link directly under the top; port getter reconstructs [TopCard]+DigivolutionCards+LinkedCards so links always sort AFTER all digivolution sources [link cards live in a separate LinkedCardIds instance-metadata list, not the single ordered cardSources list]
AS-IS DigivolutionOrLinkCards (cardSources.Filter(cs != TopCard)) has no port member; consumed by BT25_085 (BT25_085.cs:197,242)

AS-IS AddCardSource sets the new top face-up/reverse from cardSource.IsFlipped (SetFace/SetReverse); port zone move carries no FaceUp and never threads IsFlipped, so a flipped card added as top is not kept reversed

AS-IS AddDigivolutionCardsTop conditionally SetFace()s each added top source (if !IsFlipped || IsBeingRevealed || IsSecurityLooking); port AddSourcesTopAsync never sets face state on the added sources

AS-IS fires ONE OnAddDigivolutionCards for the whole added batch; port GroupBy(CurrentZoneOf) calls AddSourcesTopAsync per source-zone group, emitting once per zone group [documented design item MIG4-ADDDIGI-MULTIZONE-EMIT]

AS-IS AddDigivolutionCardsBottom re-parents another permanent whose TopCard is the added card via IPlacePermanentToDigivolutionCards (with Placed-check continue); port DetachEmbeddedSourceOrLinkAsync throws NotSupportedException for any live top on the direct path [design item MIG4-DETACH-LIVE-TOP]

AS-IS AddDigivolutionCardsBottom special-cases added==own TopCard (RemoveFromAllArea + ShowPermanentData + RemoveDigivolveRootEffect); port DetachEmbeddedSourceOrLinkAsync throws for the host's own live top instead of emitting RemoveDigivolveRootEffect [design item MIG4-DETACH-LIVE-TOP]

AS-IS isFromSameDigimon = cardSources.Contains(card) (top, source OR link); port ComputeAddDigivolutionFromFlags only checks sourceIds, so moving the host's OWN link card into digivolution sources yields isFromSameDigimon=false where AS-IS is true

AS-IS AddDigivolutionCardsBottom fires ONE OnAddDigivolutionCards for the batch; port GroupBy(CurrentZoneOf) calls AddSourcesBottomAsync per source-zone group, emitting once per zone group [documented design item MIG4-ADDDIGI-MULTIZONE-EMIT]

AS-IS AddLinkCard overflow test is (LinkedCards.Count >= LinkedMax); port adds && preLinked.Count >= 1, changing control flow when LinkedMax<=0 with no links (AS-IS would index LinkedCards[0] and throw; port no-ops)

Port AddLinkCard calls CEntity_EffectControllerStore.ResetUseCountForCard on the attached card; AS-IS AddLinkCard body (1237-1292) has no InitUseCountThisTurn/use-count reset (comment attributes it to CardController.cs:3393, a different AS-IS method)

AS-IS RemoveLinkedCard(removeCount>0) runs SelectCardEffect.Activate() synchronously (owner picks and cards are trashed before return); port RequestChoice PARKS the choice and returns immediately, so callers (AddLinkCard overflow) attach before the trims resolve [IChoiceController async park; no synchronous SelectCardEffect coroutine primitive]

AS-IS passes maxCount:removeCount (unclamped) as the SelectCardEffect selection max; port passes clamped maxCount=Min(removeCount,linked.Count) as both min and max of the ChoiceRequest, diverging when removeCount > available links
AS-IS RemoveLinkedCard selectPlayer = TopCard.Owner; port uses OwnerId (permanent controller), which can differ under control-change
AS-IS RemoveLinkedCard does LinkedDP -= LinkDP with no floor; port RemoveLinkCardAsync floors with Math.Max(0, LinkedDp - linkDp)

Port TopCard is `new CardSource(_context, InstanceId, OwnerId)` — the mirror Permanent is keyed on the top-card InstanceId itself, dropping AS-IS `cardSources.First(not-in-LinkedCards)` selection and the empty-permanent null return [CardSource/InstanceId identity model]

The 9 duration buckets (UntilOwnerTurnEnd/OwnerDrawPhase/EachTurnEnd/OpponentTurnEnd/EndBattle/EndAttack/OwnerTurnStart/NextUntap + PermanentEffects) are plain settable List fields AS-IS but delegating properties in port; get returns the live backing list (Add persists) and set replaces it, semantics match [PermanentEffectListStore/PermanentEffectLists, ConditionalWeakTable keyed by EngineContext+InstanceId, port 5866-5889]
ShowingPermanentCard (Unity UI type FieldPermanentCard) has no port counterpart — grep of whole port file finds neither ShowingPermanentCard nor FieldPermanentCard [no headless UI layer]

EnterFieldTurnCount is a plain `{get;set;}=-1` int AS-IS but a property over a boolean metadata flag in port; get returns current TurnNumber when entered-this-turn else -1, set stamps value==currentTurn, preserving all AS-IS `==TurnCount` reads [EnteredThisTurn / ZoneMoveMetadataKeys.EnteredThisTurnKey]
InvertSecutiryValue clamp uses Unity `Mathf.Clamp(Invert,-1,1)` AS-IS vs `Math.Clamp(Invert,-1,1)` in port; otherwise verbatim [System.Math replaces UnityEngine.Mathf]

Strike_AllowMinus seeds `int Strike = 1` (literal constant) AS-IS vs `int Strike = ReadSubstrateStrikeSeed()` in port (defaults to 1 when the strike metadata key is unset, production never writes it); rest of body verbatim [ReadSubstrateStrikeSeed / SecurityResolver.StrikeKey]

CanSelectBySkill/InvertSecutiryValue/SecurityAttackChanges/Strike_AllowMinus swap AS-IS `GManager.instance.turnStateMachine.gameContext.Players[_ForTurnPlayer]` for `new GameContext(_context).Players[_ForTurnPlayer]`; scan scope/interface/gate order verbatim [new GameContext(_context) replaces GManager.instance.turnStateMachine.gameContext]
DPWhenSuspended public int field (sentinel default 114514) is entirely absent from the port; sentinel 114514 not present anywhere in port file

CanMove breeding outer test changes from TopCard.PermanentOfThisCard().PermanentFrame.isBreedingAreaFrame() to GetBreedingAreaPermanents().Contains(this), making the nested !Contains(this) guard tautologically unreachable (behaviour-equivalent under frame→membership map) [Player.GetBreedingAreaPermanents membership; frame model absent RD-P6C1-1]
CanMove empty-battle-slot capacity guard (fieldCardFrames.Count(empty && battleArea)==0 → return false) is omitted, so port permits a move on a full field where AS-IS forbids it

CanBlock frame check `if(PermanentFrame!=null){if(!IsBattleAreaFrame())return false;}` becomes unconditional `if(!IsPermanentExistsOnBattleArea(this))return false;` (null-frame no longer skips the check) [CardEffectCommons.IsPermanentExistsOnBattleArea; frame model absent RD-P6C1-1]

CanAttackTargetDigimon frame check adapted the same way as CanBlock (PermanentFrame!=null gate → unconditional IsPermanentExistsOnBattleArea) [CardEffectCommons.IsPermanentExistsOnBattleArea; frame model absent RD-P6C1-1]
CanAttackTargetDigimon summoning-sickness test EnterFieldTurnCount==TurnCount replaced by EnteredThisTurn boolean substrate flag [MatchStateMutationSink.EnteredThisTurnKey / EnteredThisTurn]

Strike_AllowMinus seed changes from literal `int Strike = 1` to `ReadSubstrateStrikeSeed()`; AS-IS has NO randomizer/RNG anywhere in Strike (deterministic effect fold), so this is not an RNG substrate swap

ReadSubstrateStrikeSeed private helper has no AS-IS counterpart; reads a "strike" metadata key attributed to SecurityResolver.StrikeKey, but no SecurityResolver class/StrikeKey and no "strike" metadata writer exist in DCGO/Assets/Scripts or src (defaults to 1 = AS-IS constant, so behaviour-identical in production)
InvertSecutiryValue clamp uses Math.Clamp instead of Unity Mathf.Clamp (same [-1,1] result) [System.Math.Clamp for UnityEngine.Mathf.Clamp]

LinkedCards AS-IS public mutable List<CardSource> field becomes a computed getter reading linked-card ids from CardInstanceRepository metadata (ReadLinkedCardIds) [CardInstanceRecord.Metadata linked-card ids]

LinkedMax AS-IS inline live IChangeLinkMaxEffect scan over Players_ForTurnPlayer replaced by substrate base ReadLinkedMax folded via NewModelContinuousScan.FoldLinkedMax [NewModelContinuousScan.FoldLinkedMax + ReadLinkedMax metadata base]

IsPlaceToTrashDueToNotHavingDP AS-IS auto-property {get;set;}=true becomes a metadata-backed get/set (PlaceToTrashDueToNoDpKey), default-true / false-opt-out semantics preserved [CardInstanceRecord.Metadata PlaceToTrashDueToNoDpKey]

IsPlayedOptionPermanent AS-IS auto-property {get;set;}=false becomes a getter-ONLY metadata read (IsPlayedOptionPermanentKey); the AS-IS setter is dropped, writes relocated to CardEffectCommons metadata stamping [CardEffectCommons.IsPlayedOptionPermanentKey metadata; setter relocated]

Permanent.battle (IBattle) field absent in port; current-battle tracking / enemyPermanent lookup relocated to service CardEffectCommons.CurrentBattleOpponent(card) (IBattle type itself exists as a mirror in CardController.cs).

Plain settable int (=-1) replaced by a derived property over the enteredThisTurn boolean metadata flag; getter returns current TurnNumber when set else -1, so ==TurnCount reads reduce to the flag; turn-boundary expiry via TurnFlowPump.ExpireEnteredThisTurnFlags matches AS-IS auto-expiry, no off-by-one [ZoneMoveMetadataKeys.EnteredThisTurnKey + TurnFlowPump.ExpireEnteredThisTurnFlags]

CanBeDestroyedByBattle player-order source translated to new GameContext(_context).Players_ForTurnPlayer; all three tiers (field permanents, faceup security, player effects) and negation logic identical [GameContext.Players_ForTurnPlayer]

CanBeDestroyedBySkill player-order source translated to new GameContext(_context).Players_ForTurnPlayer; CanNotBeAffected/CanBeDestroyed guards and both scan tiers identical [GameContext.Players_ForTurnPlayer]
CanBeRemoved player-order source translated to new GameContext(_context).Players_ForTurnPlayer; both ICanNotBeRemovedEffect tiers identical [GameContext.Players_ForTurnPlayer]
CanSubstituteForDigiXrosCondition player-order source translated to new GameContext(_context).Players_ForTurnPlayer; ICanSelectDigiXrosEffect scan identical [GameContext.Players_ForTurnPlayer]
CanSubstituteForAssemblyCondition player-order source translated to new GameContext(_context).Players_ForTurnPlayer; ICanSelectAssemblyEffect scan identical [GameContext.Players_ForTurnPlayer]

CanBeDestroyed body is logic-identical; only the turn-player enumeration source changed (GManager.instance.turnStateMachine.gameContext.Players_ForTurnPlayer -> new GameContext(_context).Players_ForTurnPlayer).

IsDigimon body is logic-identical (TopCard flip/print check, then ITreatAsDigimonEffect over TopCard, then field permanents via EffectList_Added, then players); only the Players_ForTurnPlayer source changed [GameContext(_context).Players_ForTurnPlayer]

willBeRemoveField is a plain auto-property bool field in AS-IS; the port backs it with CardInstanceRepository instance-metadata ("willBeRemoveField") get/set (the IsBeingRevealed store pattern) [CardInstanceRepository metadata willBeRemoveField]

Levels_ForJogress is not on the port Permanent; it is relocated to CardSource.JogressLevelsAgainst with identical seed (material.Level gated on jogressCard.HasLevel) + IAddJogressLevelsEffect scan over field permanents and players; material permanent resolved live via ResolvePermanentOfThisCard [CardSource.cs:1306 JogressLevelsAgainst]

Names_ForDNA (CardNames seed + IAddDNANamesEffect GetDNANames scan over field permanents and players) has no consumer in the port; interface IAddDNANamesEffect.GetDNANames is declared (CardEffectInterfaces.cs:620-622) but never called anywhere in src, so the aggregator method is unimplemented.

AS-IS holds link cards in a live List<CardSource> LinkedCards field on the Permanent; the port has no such field and reads them via static ReadLinkedCardIds off the host top card's "linkedCardIds" instance metadata (newest-first, preserving Insert(0,...) order) [LinkedCardIdsKey host metadata replacing List<CardSource> LinkedCards]
AS-IS LinkedDP is a mutable int auto-property; the port reads it via static ReadLinkedDp off host "linkedDp" metadata [LinkedDpKey host metadata replacing LinkedDP field]

AS-IS LinkedMax is a full effect-folding property; the port ReadLinkedMax returns only the BASE (metadata override "linkedMax" else default 1), with the ChangeLinkedMax effect fold applied separately at the LinkedMax accessor (Permanent.cs:3042) [LinkedMaxKey base half; effect fold split out]

AS-IS RemoveLinkedCard mutates LinkedCards/LinkedDP inline and trashes via CardObjectController.AddTrashCard; the port RemoveLinkCardAsync is the STORAGE half only (list rewrite + LinkedDP subtract + IZoneMover trash), matching AS-IS :1308-1319; the removeCount>0 SelectCardEffect branch lives in the instance RemoveLinkedCard wrapper, and AS-IS's "//TODO event call" no-window behavior is preserved [metadata rewrite + IZoneMover replacing LinkedCards.Remove/AddTrashCard]

AS-IS AddLinkCard does LinkedCards.Insert(0,..)/LinkedDP += LinkDP/cardSources.Insert(1,..) inline; the port AttachLinkCard is the storage half (prepend id to "linkedCardIds", add LinkDP) as a static host-keyed metadata rewrite [metadata prepend replacing LinkedCards.Insert/LinkedDP +=]

WithLinked has no AS-IS counterpart by name; it is the metadata-writer that persists the linked-id list + linkedDp (removing both keys when empty) — the substrate persistence step for the AS-IS in-place LinkedCards/LinkedDP field mutation [metadata writer for LinkedCards/LinkedDP mutation]

ReadLinkMetadataInt has no AS-IS counterpart; it is a substrate int-coercion reader (int/long/string) over the metadata dictionary, needed because AS-IS int fields become boxed metadata values [metadata int coercion for LinkedDP/LinkedMax/LinkDP fields]

EmitWhenLinkedAsync faithfully ports AS-IS AddLinkCard's WhenLinked emit (:1281-1290): same Hashtable payload {Permanent, CardEffect, Card, isFromDigimon}, single StackSkillInfos(hashtable, EffectTiming.WhenLinked); AS-IS Photon Hashtable + GManager.autoProcessing become System.Collections.Hashtable + AutoProcessing.For(context); null CardEffect via BareCauseEffect.ForOrNull [AutoProcessing.For(context).StackSkillInfos replacing GManager.instance.autoProcessing]

The link-cluster key constants (LinkedCardIdsKey/LinkedDpKey/LinkedMaxKey "linkedMax", LinkDpKey "linkDp", DefaultLinkedMax=1) are substrate metadata keys standing in for the AS-IS live fields LinkedCards/LinkedDP/LinkedMax and CardSource.LinkDP; DefaultLinkedMax=1 mirrors the AS-IS LinkedMax default [metadata keys for LinkedCards/LinkedDP/LinkedMax/LinkDP fields]

The non-link metadata-key constants (SourceIdsKey, IsSuspendedKey, CanSuspendKey, CannotBeDeDigivolvedKey, DeletedBy*/PendingDeletion, PlaceToTrashDueToNoDpKey, IsPlayedOptionPermanentKey) are substrate metadata keys backing AS-IS bool fields/properties (IsSuspended, CanSuspend, ImmuneFromDeDigivolve static half, deletion markers, IsPlaceToTrashDueToNotHavingDP, IsPlayedOptionPermanent) that AS-IS held as live object state [instance-metadata keys for AS-IS bool fields]
IsAddedAsSourceByAppFusion field not ported; AS-IS has no .cs reader/writer either (only the field decl, dead), so omission is harmless
DigivolutionCardsColors folds mirror string colors through CardSource.ToCardColorList and drops the trailing redundant .Distinct() (both loops already dedupe via Contains, so result-equivalent)

The 10 Unity Show*/Hide*Effect methods (ShowUnsuspendEffect/ShowDeckBounceEffect/HideDeckBounceEffect/ShowHandBounceEffect/HideHandBounceEffect/ShowDeleteEffect/HideDeleteEffect/ShowWillRemoveFieldEffect/HideWillRemoveFieldEffect/ShowWillEvolutionEffect/HideWillEvolutionEffect) are purely visual GameObject/particle SetActive calls (willBeRemoveField only read, never mutated); no headless UI substrate, all omitted, referenced only in stripped-UI comments
AddSourcesBottomAsync is the static-helper substrate of AS-IS Permanent.AddDigivolutionCardsBottom (cardSources.Add + OnAddDigivolutionCards emit + skipEffectAndActivateSkill gate); faithful
AddSourcesTopAsync is the substrate of AS-IS Permanent.AddDigivolutionCardsTop (cardSources.Insert(1,..) prepend + always-fire OnAddDigivolutionCards, no skip flag); faithful

MoveSourcesBottom re-parents first N sources fromId->toId (AS-IS cardSources re-parent tail of AddDigivolutionCardsBottom); opens no OnAddDigivolutionCards window (caller's own AddDigivolutionCardsBottom did); faithful
TrashSourcesAsync delegates to RemoveSourcesAsync(destination=Trash); substrate of AS-IS ITrashDigivolutionCards.TrashDigivolutionCards bottom-window trash; faithful
TrashSpecificSourcesAsync mirrors AS-IS ITrashDigivolutionCards(permanent,selectedCards) — protection re-filter, AceOverflow before removal, token-skip AddTrashCard; faithful

RemoveSourcesAsync is the core substrate of AS-IS ITrashDigivolutionCards.TrashDigivolutionCards (CardController.cs:5148-5234): position-window collect, protection filter (trash-only), OnDigivolutionCardDiscarded emit before Upsert, AceOverflow, then move; faithful

ArmorPurgeTopAsync is the substrate of AS-IS ArmorPurgeClass.ArmorPurge (top-trash + promote cardSources[0], token top removed not trashed, no rookie floor); faithful, permanent-continuity ReKey added for the transient-view identity model
ApplyEffectTrashAceOverflow calls AS-IS AceOverflowClass.Overflow directly (CardController.cs:5836) guarded by host-on-field; faithful (real AS-IS class, not a substrate reimpl)

IsSourceTrashProtected mirrors AS-IS CardSource.CanNotTrashFromDigivolutionCards (stamp OR ICanNotTrashFromDigivolutionCardsEffect field-scan) via CardEffectCommons.IsTrashProtectedSource; deletion path passes honorProtection:false as AS-IS DiscardEvoRoots; faithful

EmitAddDigivolutionCardsAsync mirrors AS-IS AddDigivolutionCardsTop/Bottom StackSkillInfos(OnAddDigivolutionCards) payload {Permanent,CardEffect,CardSources,isFromSameDigimon,isFromDigimon}, one batch emit, null-CardEffect for rule-sourced adds; faithful

ComputeAddDigivolutionFromFlags mirrors AS-IS isFromSameDigimon (added card already in this permanent's cardSources) / isFromDigimon (added card on battle area with >=1 sources) computed PRE-move; faithful
AppendSources/PrependSources/WithSources/ReadSourceIdsFrom are the substrate of AS-IS Permanent.cardSources list ops (Add / Insert(0,..) / read); faithful, re-read target to preserve intra-op appends
PlaySpecificSourceAsync mirrors AS-IS Permanent.RemoveCardSource (sourceIds drop + physical move; destination=None => detach-only for immediate re-attach); faithful

AttachTargetAsSource mirrors AS-IS Permanent.AddCardSource digivolve top-swap (new top sourceIds = [old top]+old sources+card sources, summoning-sickness inheritance via enteredThisTurn, ReKey bookkeeping); faithful

PermanentEffectLists/PermanentEffectListStore is the coherent SUBSTRATE backing for the 9 Until*Effects duration buckets (AS-IS settable list fields Permanent.cs:1575-1608); ConditionalWeakTable(context)->ConcurrentDictionary(instanceId) returns a stable per-(context,instanceId) instance so populated lists persist across calls (no fresh-empty-list loss)
